25logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

27_BLOCK = 1024 

28_NUM_WARPS = 4 

29 

30_L_CSC = torch.sparse_csc 

31_L_BSC = torch.sparse_bsc 

32 

33# Native dispatcher spells sparse backend keys with uppercase acronyms 

34# ('SparseCUDA' / 'SparseCPU'), not device-type capitalized names. 

35_SPARSE_BACKEND_NAME = {"cuda": "SparseCUDA", "cpu": "SparseCPU"}

37# C++ layout names as printed by native ATen in the rejection message of 

38# ``aten::ccol_indices_copy`` (ATen/SparseCsrTensorUtils.h dispatch macro). 

39# Only column-compressed layouts (CSC/BSC) carry a compressed-column-index 

40# buffer. CSR/BSR/strided inputs are rejected by the native layout check with 

41# this message, so the mapping covers exactly those layouts; COO is NOT in the 

42# map because native has no kernel for it at all (the SparseCUDA key is not 

43# covered by the composite registration) and reports 

44# ``NotImplementedError`` — the fall-through delegation below reproduces that. 

45_NON_COL_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES = { 

46 torch.strided: "Strided", 

47 torch.sparse_csr: "SparseCsr", 

48 torch.sparse_bsr: "SparseBsr", 

49}

52@triton.jit 

53def _ccol_copy_kernel(src_ptr, dst_ptr, n_elem, BLOCK: tl.constexpr): 

54 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

55 offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

56 offs = tl.max_contiguous(offs, BLOCK) 

57 mask = offs < n_elem 

58 v = tl.load(src_ptr + offs, mask=mask) 

59 tl.store(dst_ptr + offs, v, mask=mask)

62@triton.jit 

63def _ccol_copy_strided_kernel(src_ptr, dst_ptr, n_elem, stride, BLOCK: tl.constexpr): 

64 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

65 offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

66 mask = offs < n_elem 

67 v = tl.load(src_ptr + offs * stride, mask=mask) 

68 tl.store(dst_ptr + offs, v, mask=mask)

71@triton.jit 

72def _ccol_copy_strided_nd_kernel( 

73 src_ptr, dst_ptr, n_elem, meta_ptr, ndim: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr 

74): 

75 # meta layout: for dim i in [0, ndim): meta[2*i] = size[i], meta[2*i+1] = stride[i] 

76 # (one int64 device tensor built host-side and uploaded in a single copy) 

77 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

78 offs = pid * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

79 mask = offs < n_elem 

80 idx = offs 

81 in_off = tl.zeros([BLOCK], dtype=tl.int64) 

82 for k in tl.static_range(ndim): 

83 i = ndim - 1 - k 

84 d = tl.load(meta_ptr + 2 * i).to(tl.int64) 

85 s = tl.load(meta_ptr + 2 * i + 1).to(tl.int64) 

86 c = idx % d 

87 idx = idx // d 

88 in_off += c * s 

89 v = tl.load(src_ptr + in_off, mask=mask) 

90 tl.store(dst_ptr + offs, v, mask=mask)

93def _select_src(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

94 """Layout dispatch shared by both overloads. 

95 

96 Returns the ``ccol_indices()`` metadata view for CSC/BSC inputs, raises the 

97 native rejection message for the other compressed/strided layouts, and 

98 delegates to the native operator for anything else. 

99 

100 The explicit guard is required by the native contract, not optional 

101 defensive code: once this implementation is registered on the backend 

102 dispatch keys (the general registrar always binds the plain device key as 

103 well), re-dispatching a strided/CSR/BSR input re-enters this override 

104 instead of reaching the native layout check, so the rejection has to be 

105 produced here. COO inputs are deliberately NOT guarded: they dispatch on 

106 the ``SparseCUDA`` key, which native never registered a kernel for, so the 

107 delegation reaches the dispatcher's own ``NotImplementedError`` — the 

108 exact native behaviour (verified: strided/CSR/BSR raise RuntimeError, COO 

109 raises NotImplementedError on this build). 

110 """ 

111 if self.layout == _L_CSC or self.layout == _L_BSC: 

112 return self.ccol_indices() 

113 if self.layout in _NON_COL_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES: 

114 layout_name = _NON_COL_COMPRESSED_LAYOUT_NAMES[self.layout] 

115 raise RuntimeError( 

116 "ccol_indices expected sparse column compressed tensor layout " 

117 f"but got {layout_name}" 

118 ) 

119 # COO and any other layout: native has no kernel for them (verified on 

120 # H20: CUDA COO raises ``NotImplementedError`` with the message below), 

121 # so the rejection is reproduced explicitly instead of redispatching to 

122 # the same operator from the host implementation. 

123 backend = _SPARSE_BACKEND_NAME.get(self.device.type, "Sparse") 

124 raise NotImplementedError( 

125 "Could not run 'aten::ccol_indices_copy' with arguments from the " 

126 f"'{backend}' backend. This could be because the operator doesn't " 

127 "exist for that backend." 

128 )

131def _launch_ccol_copy(src: torch.Tensor, dst: torch.Tensor) -> None: 

132 """Copy the ``src`` ccol view into ``dst`` with the three kernels below. 

133 

134 Contiguous sources take the flat kernel; a non-contiguous 1-D source takes 

135 the single-stride gather kernel; a non-contiguous multi-dim (batched) 

136 source takes the ND-strided gather kernel, which reads through per-dim 

137 size/stride metadata uploaded in one H2D copy. Empty tensors skip the 

138 launch entirely (the grid would be ``(0,)``), mirroring the source's 

139 ``if n:`` guard. 

140 """ 

141 n = src.numel() 

142 if n == 0: 

143 return 

144 grid = (triton.cdiv(n, _BLOCK),) 

145 if src.is_contiguous(): 

146 with torch_device_fn.device(src.device): 

147 _ccol_copy_kernel[grid](src, dst, n, BLOCK=_BLOCK, num_warps=_NUM_WARPS) 

148 elif src.dim() == 1: 

149 with torch_device_fn.device(src.device): 

150 _ccol_copy_strided_kernel[grid]( 

151 src, dst, n, src.stride(0), BLOCK=_BLOCK, num_warps=_NUM_WARPS 

152 ) 

153 else: 

154 # Multi-dim non-contiguous ccol buffer: gather through per-dim 

155 # size/stride metadata (built host-side, uploaded in one H2D copy). 

156 # Native ATen handles these inputs, so the branch is part of the 

157 # contract (review: this closes the previously disclosed divergence). 

158 shape = [int(v) for v in src.shape] 

159 strides = [int(v) for v in src.stride()] 

160 meta = torch.tensor( 

161 [v for s, st in zip(shape, strides) for v in (s, st)], 

162 dtype=torch.int64, 

163 device=src.device, 

164 ) 

165 with torch_device_fn.device(src.device): 

166 _ccol_copy_strided_nd_kernel[grid]( 

167 src, dst, n, meta, ndim=len(shape), BLOCK=_BLOCK, num_warps=_NUM_WARPS 

168 )

171def ccol_indices_copy(self: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

172 """Return a fresh contiguous copy of a CSC/BSC tensor's compressed columns. 

173 

174 Mirrors ``aten::ccol_indices_copy(Tensor self) -> Tensor``: the result is a 

175 newly allocated, contiguous, independent int64 tensor holding the input's 

176 compressed-column-index array (``batch_dims + (ncols + 1,)`` for CSC, 

177 ``batch_dims + (n_col_blocks + 1,)`` for BSC). The input is never mutated 

178 and the result never aliases the input's internal ccol storage (fresh 

179 ``data_ptr``, ``_base is None``); verified against native ATen on H20. 

180 

181 Only column-compressed layouts are accepted. Strided/CSR/BSR inputs are 

182 rejected with the native ``RuntimeError`` ("ccol_indices expected sparse 

183 column compressed tensor layout but got <Layout>"); COO falls through to 

184 the dispatcher's native ``NotImplementedError`` (native has no kernel for 

185 the Sparse key). The guard raises the RuntimeError itself because a 

186 re-dispatch of a strided/CSR/BSR input re-enters this override once 

187 registered on the backend dispatch keys (the registrar always binds the 

188 plain device key as well), so the native check is unreachable for them. 

189 

190 The data movement is performed by the three Triton kernels below, selected 

191 by the source layout: a flat copy for a contiguous source, a single-stride 

192 gather for a non-contiguous 1-D source, and an ND-strided gather for a 

193 non-contiguous multi-dim (batched) source, which reads through per-dim 

194 size/stride metadata uploaded in one H2D copy. All three cases match native 

195 ATen; there is no disclosed divergence. The batched strided path is covered 

196 by ``test_accuracy_ccol_indices_copy_strided_ccol_multi_dim``. 

197 

198 Tensors built through the public sparse constructors always expose a 

199 contiguous ccol array, so the two gather branches serve hand-built 

200 metadata; native accepts those inputs, so they are implemented rather than 

201 rejected. 

202 """ 

203 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME_GCU400 CCOL_INDICES_COPY") 

204 src = _select_src(self) 

205 out = torch.empty_like(src) 

206 _launch_ccol_copy(src, out) 

207 return out

210def ccol_indices_copy_out(self: torch.Tensor, *, out: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor: 

211 """Variant of :func:`ccol_indices_copy` that writes into ``out``. 

212 

213 Mirrors ``aten::ccol_indices_copy.out``: the ``out`` tensor must carry the 

214 ccol dtype (int64 for default-index tensors, int32 for int32 index 

215 tensors), is resized to ``batch_dims + (ncols + 1,)`` when its shape 

216 differs, receives the ccol values through the same Triton kernels, and is 

217 returned itself (native aliasing contract: the returned tensor IS the 

218 ``out`` argument). A non-contiguous ``out`` is written through a contiguous 

219 staging buffer, matching the native behaviour of writing element-wise 

220 through the out strides. 

221 """ 

222 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME_GCU400 CCOL_INDICES_COPY_OUT") 

223 src = _select_src(self) 

224 if out.dtype != src.dtype: 

225 raise RuntimeError( 

226 f"Expected out tensor to have dtype {src.dtype}, but got {out.dtype} instead" 

227 ) 

228 if out.device != src.device: 

229 # Native rejects a cross-device out before launching the kernel 

230 # (verified on H20: CUDA sparse + CPU out raises this exact message); 

231 # without the guard the Triton launch would receive pointers from 

232 # different devices instead of raising. 

233 raise RuntimeError( 

234 f"Expected out tensor to have device {src.device}, but got " 

235 f"{out.device} instead" 

236 ) 

237 if tuple(out.shape) != tuple(src.shape): 

238 out.resize_(src.shape) 

239 dst = out if out.is_contiguous() else out.contiguous() 

240 _launch_ccol_copy(src, dst) 

241 if dst.data_ptr() != out.data_ptr(): 

242 out.copy_(dst) 

243 return out
